description: Settlement Dry Run — returns the full oracle response a real /settle call would receive, without payment or on-chain execution. Runs live oracle gate, live compliance pre-check, and fee math. Use this to demonstrate the settlement flow to a human, onboard a new agent, or verify oracle conditions before committing a payment. No authentication required, no USDC needed. Returns: oracle status and score, compliance tier, fee estimate, stablecoin routing, and a plain-language settlement brief. Free.
name: settlement.try
